* Compare two byte arrays in lexicographical order.
 *
 * @author D. N. Hoover

methods.name: public final int compare(byte[] bytes1, byte[] bytes2)
methods.comment: * Perform lexicographical comparison of two byte arrays, * regarding each byte as unsigned. That is, compare array entries * in order until they differ--the array with the smaller entry * is "smaller". If array entries are * equal till one array ends, then the longer array is "bigger". * * @param bytes1 first byte array to compare. * @param bytes2 second byte array to compare. * @return negative number if {@code bytes1 < bytes2}, * 0 if {@code bytes1 == bytes2}, * positive number if {@code bytes1 > bytes2}. * * @exception ClassCastException * if either argument is not a byte array.

methodNames: public final int compare(byte[] bytes1, byte[] bytes2)
